photos.view: rear three-quarter view from the rear right, in a workshop, dim lighting

vehicle_check.seen: Silver Kia minivan/MPV with a Kia badge on the tailgate, seen from the rear

findings.reason: Left part of the rear bumper is crushed and pushed in with a sharp crease and torn or displaced sections, and the bumper is misaligned.
The lower tailgate is buckled and creased on the left and centre, with the panel pushed in and distorted around the plate area.
The left tail lamp area at the edge is partly covered or taped and looks displaced, but it is hard to see in the dim photo.

structural_reason: The rear bumper and the lower tailgate are heavily crushed and buckled, which suggests the impact may have reached the rear panel and the structure behind the bumper.
